entries.message: This update includes align up next with media detail state, respect episode release dates when marking watched, add TV shows to Up Next rail, add Tautulli history import and watch sync, refine settings layouts and help guides, align settings and sync activity issues, and clarify sync activity issue guidance.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Up Next now follows each show's media-page watch state and will not skip ahead to a later episode.
Keep season and show watch history on or after each episode's release date, with an explicit opt-in for early online releases.
Add TV shows from the media page and three-dot menu, while keeping the dashboard rail limited to released episodes available on a connected media server.
Add reviewable Tautulli history imports and provider-aware historical watch synchronization.
Standardize settings sections, help content, and documentation links across the settings pages.
Surface unresolved media matches in Sync Activity and standardize the settings layouts and help panels.
Direct users to Sync Activity for unresolved matches and current sync failures.
Remove stale standalone match-report help from the settings flow.
